purpose: Try four-digit hands again and straighten the head/gaze on the newly selected Sprig design
prompt:
Edit the supplied newly approved cute Sprig character with ONLY TWO requested corrections: 1) clean four-digit cartoon hands, and 2) a perfectly straight head and gaze directly at the viewer. Preserve the approved character identity and everything else.

HANDS: replace each mitten with a SMALL anatomically coherent simple CARTOON HAND, exactly FOUR DIGITS TOTAL per hand: THREE short chubby rounded fingers and ONE smaller distinct THUMB. Both palms face mostly toward the viewer, fingers gently open with small clear gaps, same natural mirrored anatomy and same size. Three fingers should emerge from the rounded outer end of each palm as a neat softly fanned row; the thumb comes from the inner upper side, clearly separate and opposite the three fingers. Short smooth capsule-like fingers, balanced lengths, no knuckle creases, no fingernails, no human-realistic anatomy. Fingers must NOT twist, cross, overlap, branch, fuse or point in random directions. No extra bumps, no fifth digit and no remaining mitten. Keep the hands small and cuddly relative to the tiny body; do not enlarge the arms or palms. Same light pistachio skin as the body. Keep arms gently angled outward and down so palms and all four digits are visible, with clear space between hands and torso.

HEAD AND EYES: straighten the actual head to EXACTLY UPRIGHT, no tilt, no roll, no sideways yaw. Frontal orthographic view. The two eye centers are on the SAME perfectly horizontal line; the small nose is exactly centered above the mouth; the mouth is centered on the face's vertical centerline. Both irises and pupils look STRAIGHT AHEAD at the viewer, centered consistently within their eye openings with balanced whites, no side glance, looking upward, wandering eye or cross-eyed convergence. Preserve the same expressive dark brown eyes, size, soft cream whites and warm catchlights, green brows, rosy cheeks, tiny nose and joyful open smile. Do not make the facial expression blank or change the shape or cuteness of the face.

Preserve the ASYMMETRICAL leaf hairstyle exactly: its big diagonal swept leaf and uneven leaf arrangement stay asymmetric even though the face/head is now held straight. Do not rotate the face to follow the diagonal leaf quiff. Keep the same leaves, broad stylized sculpted folds, colors, leaf collar, tiny pudgy body, stubby legs, green feet, soft satin materials, warm premium cozy game lighting, cream background and subtle ground shadow. No redesign, no palette change, no additional views, labels, accessories or text. Full unclipped single character, generous margins. Make the front-facing eye contact unmistakable and the four-digit hands simple, clean and well formed.
